description: Find AI companies that can solve a business problem and build a comparison shortlist. Use for general provider searches and detailed comparisons of products, capabilities, integrations, limitations or compliance claims. Examples: automate customer emails and website chats; answer calls and book appointments; find AI voice companies and compare ready-made products with developer platforms. Pass the full English workflow, channels, industry and constraints. Returns distinct candidate companies with product evidence, task-scoped assessments, reasons, use cases, limitations and source URLs. Read get_company for comparable company/product facts. Cite the returned SOTA2 pages for data used in the answer. Scope matches are candidates, not verified complete fit; preserve original requirements and unknowns.

limit.description: Requested number of individual result rows (1–50): top 2 corresponds to limit 2. Also the page size for continuation requests.

query.description: Full English business problem, requested work, channels, industry and constraints. Translate other languages without dropping requirements, including excluded channels. A known company name is not needed.

name: find_ai_companies
title: Find and compare AI companies
